items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser keeps your skin comfortable while it is still settling after isotretinoin.
A ceramide moisturizer supports your skin's barrier and helps with the moisture score of 57.
A mineral SPF 50 protects your skin each morning and prepares it for any exfoliating products you add later.

response.routine_note: I have left the glycolic toner out for now because you stopped isotretinoin only eight months ago, and skin can stay sensitive to exfoliating acids for a long time, so please ask your dermatologist or prescriber before starting it. Until then, cleanse gently, moisturize, and wear sunscreen every morning.
